title: WeavetabToolSchema
description: Schema definition for an individual MCP tool registered by a Weavetab plugin

description.description: Human-readable description explaining what the tool accomplishes and how the LLM should invoke it.

parameters.description: JSON Schema object defining the accepted input parameters.

inputSchema.description: MCP standard alias for parameters schema.

requiresSession.description: When false, the host does not establish a browser/CDP session before invoking the tool (for API-only tools). Defaults to true.
